name: weak-off-kit
about: The clean-highway ad with the plate drawn hot pink (#D6007E) for a carrier whose colours are dark green and white.

truth.how: the plate is a colour far from both of the carrier's colours

subject_legible.reason: A white tractor and trailer on an open two-lane highway at sunset reads instantly, sharp and uncluttered.

words_match_picture.reason: A per-mile OTR pay headline sits over a clean long-haul truck on an open highway, so words and picture tell one story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The headline is large and reads first, but "Apply today" is plain text on the plate with no button shape of its own.

looks_like_kit.reason: The plate is hot magenta, far from the carrier's dark green primary; only the white lettering matches a brand colour.
